text.en:
The provision of Section sixteen hundred seventy-four of the Administrative Code, as amended,
relative to the number of assistant provincial fiscals in the Province of Surigao del Sur, is further amended to
read as follows:
"Surigao del Sur, four assistant provincial fiscals."
